decisions.statement: The index is named for the unique kind it files.
A file is found by the page type, the scoping property and its value, then the property and value.
A scope is a property's value under a page type.
A scoping value naming its page type is filed under the slug alone.
A page carrying no value of the property scoping it is filed nowhere.
A page type declaring this kind and naming no scoping property is a fault.
No two pages have one slug inside the scope that slug's property declares.
A file has one line for each page with the value.
A scope no page is filed under has no directory.
A page with an identifier another page already has does not land.

definition: an index from an identifier unique among the pages sharing one property's value to the page with it
